Best Available Techniques (BAT) Reference Document for the Production of Pulp, Paper and Board. Industrial Emissions Directive 2010/75/EU (Integrated Pollution Prevention and Control). JRC Science and Policy Report EUR 27235 EN, JRC95678. Luxembourg: Publications Office of the European Union. ISBN 978-92-79-48167-3, doi:10.2791/370629.

Targeted pass of a 906-page BREF. Locators are PRINTED page numbers (PDF page = printed + 38). Data are EU (some plant examples from SE, FI, DE, ES; Veracel BR and Fray Bentos UY only in other-values). Loaded: whole-mill and per-unit energy for kraft (Table 3.5, KAM2 reference mill Tables 3.29/3.32, Sodra Varo, Table 3.31, indicative levels), sulphite (Tables 4.6-4.8, 4.32), mechanical/CTMP (Tables 5.10, 5.13, 5.15, 5.17, Sect. 5.3.9, 5.4), RCF (Tables 6.4, 6.5, 6.25-6.28) and papermaking (Tables 7.9, 7.11, 7.18, 7.30, Sect. 7.3.15); recovery boiler, high-solids firing (incremental costs), black liquor gasification, lime kiln and gasifier firing, oxygen delignification and TCF/ozone costs, effluent treatment energy and costs, CHP efficiencies (Table 2.12) and 2010 CHP investment costs (ASPAPEL), heat pump on PM exhaust, shoe press. Whole-mill rows are named pulp-mill_/paper-mill_/pulp-and-paper-mill_ and mapped (none). Measures file: all quantified energy techniques (Sect. 2.9.6, Ch. 3, 5, 6, Table 7.29, 7.3.15). Not loaded: BAT-AELs and emissions to air/water, water, waste, noise, Table 2.9 (overlaps indicative tables; in other-values), figures read only from charts (Figs 3.48-3.53, Sankey 7.32-7.33), Table 7.31 example mills, biorefinery qualitative text. Heat values are steam at thermal capacity (BREF boundary note) and LHV for any gas IR/air dryer share in the indicative whole-mill tables. Costs carry no price year except CHP (2010); 2015 used and flagged. ADt = air-dry tonne (90 % dry).

(1) Tables 4.7 and 4.8 print process heat with a space as decimal mark (e.g. 2 314 = 2.314 GJ/ADt, total 8 086 = 8.086); loaded as decimals with notes. (2) Table 4.8 electricity column is misaligned for several departments; only rows with unambiguous alignment loaded; operator total does not add up (source footnote). (3) Table 7.18 heat for tissue mills printed as MJ/tonne but values (5.4-21) are GJ/t; loaded as GJ/t. (4) Table 6.26 power rows sum to 350 kWh/t vs printed total 400; Table 6.27 rows sum to 860 vs printed 900. (5) Table 2.9 and Table 7.11 headers are ambiguous in layout; Table 7.11 first column read as paper machine without stock preparation (supplier). (6) Lime kiln energy on p.242 (1.5-1.8 GJ/t pulp) includes purchased burnt lime, while p.344 gives 1.1-1.4 GJ/ADt for the kiln itself. (7) Most cost figures have no price year and no clear cost basis (new vs retrofit); the measure cost of the shoe press is per machine width, not tonnage. (8) Table 7.32 source cited as Blum et al. 2009 but text cites Blum et al. 2007.
